query:
SELECT p.id, p.name, p.isComposite, p.currentStock, 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM productCompositions WHERE parentProductId = p.id) as num_components
FROM products p 
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Original 269ml%' OR p.name LIKE '%Pack%'
ORDER BY p.id DESC;
